lines.say: You went back to floor minus one. Now there is a button below it.
Minus two. The clerks down here collect rent from minus one.
Minus three. Minus four. Every floor pays the floor below it.
The last button says minus nine. You live on nine.
The doors open on a hallway. Your doormat. Your door. Your light is on.
Would you press minus nine? Write it in the comments.
